summary_md: **Raymond R. ([@greyreddington](https://x.com/greyreddington/status/2115643319783239758))** open-sourced **Excalibur Agent Hub**, a local chat room for you and your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and others), with no account or cloud.
